text: Some rural Missouri interstates will soon go from 70 to 75 mph after MoDOT picked the stretches allowed under a new state law. Cruise control, meet your new setting.
Missouri State Board of Education members split at their Oct. 20 meeting over the state's plan to grade every public school and district A through F. Report cards, now for the grown-ups.
Missouri Interim Education Commissioner Stacey Preis resigned Oct. 20, effective immediately, as the State Board of Education keeps searching for a permanent leader. Help wanted, Jefferson City.
The Kansas City Chiefs beat the Los Angeles Chargers 22-6 Oct. 18 to go 5-0, and Patrick Mahomes earned his 100th career win. Red Friday never ends.
Number 13 Missouri lost 31-3 at number 9 Ole Miss Oct. 17 in Oxford, Mississippi, falling to 5-2. Tiger fans, there's always next Saturday.
